lead_summary.zh: 美軍再擊伊朗；國安基金第10度進場
lead_summary.en: US strikes Iran again; Taiwan fund steps in

title.zh: 美軍再對伊朗有限打擊　另組特遣隊封鎖陸運
title.en: US makes new limited strike on Iran, forms task force on land routes

body.zh: 美國總統川普 6 日表示，美軍對伊朗發動新一輪有限度打擊，目標是一處防空系統，他形容行動規模「非常小」；伊朗官媒報導格什姆島傳出兩聲爆炸，這是 3 日期中選舉後美軍首度對伊朗動武。路透 7 日報導，美軍中央司令部將成立「鐵門特遣部隊」，限制伊朗經陸路邊境與裏海運送武器及受制裁物資，並估計海上封鎖已使伊朗少出口逾 250 億美元原油。另據兩名中東官員表示，伊朗正評估主要調停方卡達提出的核問題方案，但堅持美方須先接受其停火核心條件；白宮對方案不予置評，川普則稱雙方一直都在對話。
body.en: President Donald Trump said on the 6th that US forces carried out a new round of limited strikes on Iran targeting an air defense system, calling the operation "very small"; Iranian state media reported two explosions on Qeshm Island, in the first US military action against Iran since the November 3 midterms. Reuters reported on the 7th that US Central Command will set up "Task Force Iron Gate" to curb Iranian shipments of weapons and sanctioned goods across land borders and the Caspian Sea, estimating the naval blockade has already kept more than US$25 billion of Iranian crude off the market. Two Middle Eastern officials said Iran is reviewing a nuclear proposal from chief mediator Qatar but insists Washington first accept its core ceasefire conditions; the White House declined to comment on the proposal, while Trump said the two sides have always been talking.

title.zh: 波蘭克拉科夫槍擊　至少6死15傷
title.en: Kraków shooting leaves at least 6 dead, 15 hurt

body.zh: 波蘭第二大城克拉科夫 7 日下午約 3 時，一名男子在舊城區中央廣場附近開槍，造成至少 6 人死亡、15 人受傷。據法新社報導，嫌犯身穿迷彩服、持軍用型長槍，開車進入廣場後隨機掃射，被趕到的警方開槍擊中後送醫並遭拘捕，警方另在車內查獲多把武器與彈藥。嫌犯據報為單獨犯案的波蘭公民，動機仍不明；總理圖斯克趕赴當地，美國駐波蘭大使也發文譴責攻擊。
body.en: A gunman opened fire near the main square of the Old Town in Kraków, Poland's second-largest city, at about 3 p.m. on the 7th, killing at least six people and injuring 15. According to AFP, the suspect, wearing camouflage and carrying a military-style long gun, drove into the square and fired at random before police shot him; he was taken to hospital and detained, and officers found more weapons and ammunition in his car. The suspect is reported to be a Polish citizen who acted alone, and his motive is unknown; Prime Minister Donald Tusk headed to the city, and the US ambassador to Poland condemned the attack.

title.zh: 巴拉圭前總統遭起訴　檢方聲請羈押
title.en: Paraguay charges ousted president Peña, seeks detention

body.zh: 巴拉圭國會 6 日彈劾免職總統潘尼亞後，副總統阿里亞納隨即宣誓就任，將做完至 2028 年 8 月的任期。檢方 7 日以背信與圖利等罪起訴潘尼亞並聲請預防性羈押，前央行總裁也一併被起訴；檢方指控潘尼亞利用職權影響政府機關與國營事業，使大筆公帑存入已倒閉的 ueno 銀行，並與該行維持財務關係、構成利益衝突。潘尼亞否認不法，稱銀行問題屬監理事務，他目前遭居家監禁，律師尚未回應置評。
body.en: After Congress impeached and removed President Santiago Peña on the 6th, Vice President Pedro Alliana was quickly sworn in to serve out the term through August 2028. On the 7th prosecutors charged Peña with breach of trust and improperly benefiting others and asked for pretrial detention, also charging former central bank governor Carlos Carvallo; they allege Peña used his office to sway state agencies and state companies into depositing large sums of public money at the now-collapsed ueno bank while keeping financial ties to it, creating a conflict of interest. Peña denies wrongdoing and says the bank's troubles are a regulatory matter; he is under house arrest, and his lawyer had not responded to requests for comment.

title.zh: 紐西蘭大選初步開票　兩大黨難分高下
title.en: New Zealand election too close to call

body.zh: 紐西蘭 7 日舉行大選，路透引述選委會資料，開出逾 95% 選票時，執政的國家黨與最大在野黨工黨得票率都略低於 30%，差距僅數千票；選委會席次推估顯示，國家黨領導的三黨聯盟以 2 席之差維持過半。總理拉克森表示國家黨可望成為國會最大黨、有機會組成下屆政府，但選情仍非常接近；工黨黨魁希普金斯則說，還需要時間釐清選民傳達的訊息。海外與跨選區投下的特別票尚待計入，正式結果將於 11 月 27 日公布。
body.en: In New Zealand's general election on the 7th, Reuters, citing the Electoral Commission, said that with more than 95% of votes counted the governing National Party and the main opposition Labour Party each had just under 30%, separated by only a few thousand votes; the commission's seat projection showed the National-led three-party coalition holding a two-seat majority. Prime Minister Christopher Luxon said National was set to be the largest party and had a path to forming the next government but that the race remained very close; Labour leader Chris Hipkins said more time was needed to understand what voters had said. Special votes from overseas and out-of-electorate voters are still to be counted, with official results due on November 27.

title.zh: 川習APEC會前　中美財經官員通話
title.en: US, Chinese officials talk ahead of Trump-Xi APEC meeting

body.zh: 中國國務院副總理何立峰 6 日晚間與美國財政部長貝森特、貿易代表葛里爾視訊通話，為川普與習近平預計 18 至 19 日在深圳 APEC 峰會期間的會晤鋪路，這將是兩人今年第 3 度會面。中方對美方近期的對中經貿限制表達嚴正關切，雙方同意持續運用經貿磋商機制管控分歧。貝森特強調中方須「全面且立即」落實釜山峰會承諾，並將以實際成果檢視進展；葛里爾則表示，美方關注中國採購農產品以及稀土等關鍵礦產。
body.en: Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng held a video call on the evening of the 6th with US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Trade Representative Jamieson Greer, laying groundwork for a Trump-Xi meeting expected at the APEC summit in Shenzhen on November 18-19, which would be their third meeting this year. Beijing expressed serious concern about recent US trade restrictions on China, and both sides agreed to keep using their trade consultation mechanism to manage differences. Bessent said China must "fully and immediately" implement its commitments from the Busan summit and that the US will judge progress by results; Greer said Washington is focused on Chinese purchases of farm goods and of rare earths and other critical minerals.

title.zh: 俄軍夜襲基輔　北橋受損能源設施遭擊
title.en: Russian strikes damage Kyiv bridge, energy sites

body.zh: 俄羅斯 7 日凌晨空襲基輔一帶，基輔市長克里契科表示，北橋路面與電車、電力線路受損，雙向封閉檢查，基輔與日托米爾州的能源設施也遭擊中，造成首都供暖與供水中斷，他形容能源供應情況極為困難；當局初步通報 5 人受傷。烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基警告俄方將持續攻擊能源與民用設施，再度呼籲盡快交付愛國者攔截飛彈，並表示俄羅斯將會得到烏方的回應。
body.en: Russian strikes hit the Kyiv area early on the 7th; Mayor Vitali Klitschko said the road surface, trolleybus line and a power line on the Pivnichnyi Bridge were damaged and the bridge was closed in both directions for inspection, while energy facilities in the Kyiv and Zhytomyr regions were hit, disrupting heating and water in the capital, a supply situation he called extremely difficult; authorities initially reported five people injured. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy warned of further attacks on energy and civilian infrastructure, renewed calls for faster delivery of Patriot interceptors and said Russia would get Ukraine's response.

title.zh: 國安基金第10度進場　盼穩台股信心
title.en: Taiwan's stabilization fund steps in for 10th time

body.zh: 台股 6 日重挫失守 4 萬點，國家金融安定基金當天下午召開臨時委員會，決議授權執行秘書視情況動用資金執行護盤任務，為成立以來第 10 度進場；金管會限空令等措施則自 9 日（週一）起實施。國安基金表示，台灣經濟基本面穩健，但台股高科技權重高、與費城半導體指數連動緊密，短期投資信心轉弱，已符合設置條例第 8 條要件。加權指數 11 月 2 日至 6 日累計下跌 5,510 點，較今年高點 49,968 點回落 20.55%；外資 10 月賣超約 9,943 億元創單月紀錄，11 月以來再賣超 5,244 億元。
body.en: After the TAIEX tumbled below 40,000 on the 6th, Taiwan's National Financial Stabilization Fund held an extraordinary committee meeting that afternoon and authorized its executive secretary to deploy money as conditions warrant to support the market, the fund's 10th intervention; the FSC's short-selling curbs and related measures take effect on Monday, the 9th. The fund said Taiwan's fundamentals are sound but the tech-heavy market moves closely with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index and short-term confidence has weakened, meeting the conditions of Article 8 of its governing act. The index fell 5,510 points from November 2 to 6 and is 20.55% below this year's high of 49,968; foreign investors sold a record net NT$994.3 billion in October and another NT$524.4 billion so far in November.

title.zh: 油價單週重挫約13%　布蘭特失守百元
title.en: Oil drops about 13% on the week, Brent below $100

body.zh: 據 VOCO 報導，布蘭特原油 6 日報每桶 98.32 美元、小漲 0.03 美元，西德州原油報 90.83 美元、漲 0.31 美元，兩者本週都重挫約 13%。市場預期美國期中選舉後美伊軍事衝突可望轉向外交降溫，加上需求疲弱、供給過剩疑慮升高，壓抑油價；中東油輪遇襲引發供應中斷擔憂，則讓週五價格止穩。
body.en: According to VOCO, Brent crude stood at US$98.32 a barrel on the 6th, up 3 cents, and WTI at US$90.83, up 31 cents, with both down about 13% for the week. Expectations that the US-Iran conflict could shift toward diplomatic de-escalation after the US midterms, along with weak demand and growing oversupply worries, weighed on prices; attacks on tankers in the Middle East revived supply-disruption fears and steadied prices on Friday.

title.zh: 60萬顆輝達晶片滯港　待北京放行
title.en: 600,000 Nvidia chips held in Hong Kong awaiting Beijing

body.zh: 路透引述知情人士報導，約 60 萬顆輝達 H200 AI 晶片目前存放在香港，等待北京核准大規模輸入中國大陸，這批庫存此前未曾公開。中央社引述港媒評論分析，北京在短期算力需求與長期技術自主之間取捨，藉由控制核准節奏限制進口總量，允許有限度用於模型訓練，推論則優先採用國產伺服器。這批晶片已付款並完成所有權轉移，延宕將增加溢價與融資成本，也面臨晶片過時貶值的風險。
body.en: Reuters, citing people familiar with the matter, reported that about 600,000 Nvidia H200 AI chips are being held in Hong Kong awaiting Beijing's approval for large-scale import into mainland China, a previously undisclosed stockpile. A Hong Kong media commentary cited by CNA said Beijing is weighing short-term computing needs against long-term technological self-reliance, using the pace of approvals to cap imports, allowing limited use for model training while favoring domestic servers for inference. The chips have already been paid for and changed hands, so delays add premium and financing costs and risk losses as the chips become outdated.

title.zh: 中國首在加發人民幣國債　中加對話重啟
title.en: China to sell first yuan bonds in Canada as dialogue resumes

body.zh: 中國財政部 5 日公告，將於 9 日當週首度在加拿大發行人民幣計價的綠色主權債券，規模不超過 40 億元人民幣。停擺 8 年的中加經濟財金戰略對話預計 9 日重啟，國務院副總理何立峰將赴加拿大出席。分析人士認為，此舉反映加拿大總理卡尼上任後雙邊關係回溫，也顯示北京推動人民幣國際化、降低對美元依賴的意圖；中加關係曾因 2018 年孟晚舟在溫哥華被捕而惡化。
body.en: China's Ministry of Finance announced on the 5th that it will issue yuan-denominated green sovereign bonds in Canada for the first time during the week of November 9, raising no more than 4 billion yuan. The China-Canada Economic and Financial Strategic Dialogue, stalled for eight years, is expected to resume on the 9th, with Vice Premier He Lifeng attending in Canada. Analysts said the move reflects warming ties since Prime Minister Mark Carney took office and Beijing's push to internationalize the yuan and reduce reliance on the US dollar; relations had soured after Huawei executive Meng Wanzhou's 2018 arrest in Vancouver.

title.zh: 碳化矽削價競爭　安森美喊停捷克擴廠
title.en: onsemi scraps US$2 billion Czech SiC expansion

body.zh: 美國半導體廠安森美（onsemi）6 日宣布，取消 2024 年規劃在捷克東部羅日諾夫投資 20 億美元、建立完整碳化矽（SiC）供應鏈的擴廠計畫，理由是全球碳化矽晶圓市場生變，並強調與捷克投資環境無關，既有生產不受影響。捷克工貿部長哈夫利切克表示，當地生產將持續，安森美仍規劃在當地的其他投資。捷克媒體分析指出，中國碳化矽業者受惠於補貼與低電價，報價遠低於西方同業，是安森美縮減產能的背景；該公司今年 5 月已宣布裁減 200 至 300 個主要與碳化矽晶圓製造相關的職位。
body.en: US chipmaker onsemi said on the 6th that it has canceled a US$2 billion expansion at Rožnov pod Radhoštěm in the eastern Czech Republic, announced in 2024 to build a full silicon carbide (SiC) supply chain, citing changes in the global SiC wafer market and stressing the decision does not reflect on the Czech investment climate and existing output is unaffected. Czech Industry and Trade Minister Karel Havlíček said production in Rožnov will continue and onsemi still plans other investments in the country. Czech media analysis pointed to Chinese SiC suppliers, helped by subsidies and cheap power, pricing far below Western rivals; onsemi announced in May that it would cut 200 to 300 jobs, mainly in SiC wafer manufacturing.

headline.zh: 台股重挫1,873點失守4萬　盤中曾跌3,737點

body.zh: 加權指數 6 日大幅跳空開低 2,658.96 點，盤中最低來到 37,837.05 點、一度大跌 3,737.67 點，為史上最大盤中跌點，隨後跌幅收斂，終場跌 1,873.08 點收 39,701.64 點、失守 4 萬點，為史上第 4 大收盤跌點、連續第 7 個交易日下跌，成交值 1 兆 2,461.04 億元；櫃買指數跌 5.43%。台積電開盤即跌停至 2,020 元，終場收 2,135 元、跌 4.69%，鴻海跌 4.47%、聯發科跌 2.02%、台達電跌 6.64%、日月光投控跌 7.87%，信驊跌停；上市個股 106 家上漲、976 家下跌、27 家持平。美股前一晚重挫、日韓股市同步大跌，加上融資斷頭與外資賣壓，拖累盤勢；行政院長卓榮泰表示已指示金管會密切關注並視需要採取穩定措施，盤中承接買盤進場，跌幅隨之縮小。
body.en: The TAIEX gapped down 2,658.96 points at the open on the 6th and hit an intraday low of 37,837.05, down as much as 3,737.67 points, the largest intraday point drop on record, before paring losses to close down 1,873.08 points at 39,701.64, below 40,000, the fourth-largest closing point drop on record and a seventh straight losing session, on turnover of NT$1.246 trillion; the TPEx index fell 5.43%. TSMC opened limit-down at NT$2,020 and closed at NT$2,135, down 4.69%, while Hon Hai lost 4.47%, MediaTek 2.02%, Delta 6.64% and ASE 7.87%, and ASPEED hit limit-down; among listed stocks 106 rose, 976 fell and 27 were unchanged. A steep overnight US selloff, parallel slides in Japan and Korea, forced margin selling and foreign outflows weighed on the market; Premier Cho Jung-tai said he had told the FSC to watch closely and take stabilizing steps as needed, and bargain buying narrowed the losses during the session.

flows_note.zh: 投信買超主要集中台積電；上市櫃融資餘額合計單日大減 564.18 億元。
flows_note.en: Investment trusts' buying centered on TSMC; combined margin loans on listed and OTC stocks fell by NT$56.418 billion in a day.

headline.zh: 美股11/6：費半反彈4.21%　道瓊續跌237點
headline.en: US close, Nov 6: SOX rebounds 4.21%; Dow slips 237

body.zh: 前一日 AI 股大逃殺後，部分資金逢低承接，晶片股領軍反彈，費半漲 4.21%，AMD 漲 11%、英特爾漲 7.71%、美光漲 5.12%、輝達漲 2.78%，台積電 ADR 漲 6.33% 收 375.44 美元，那斯達克與標普 500 收高，道瓊則續跌 237.33 點。10 月非農就業大增 16.5 萬人、遠優於預期，市場評估聯準會 12 月升息的可能性，十年期美債殖利率升至約 4.86%；市場仍擔心民主黨掌控國會後資料中心建置放緩，布蘭特原油則跌破每桶 100 美元。
body.en: After the previous day's AI rout, some investors bought the dip and chipmakers led a rebound: the SOX rose 4.21%, with AMD up 11%, Intel 7.71%, Micron 5.12% and Nvidia 2.78%, and the TSMC ADR gained 6.33% to US$375.44; the Nasdaq and S&P 500 closed higher, while the Dow slipped another 237.33 points. October payrolls jumped 165,000, far above expectations, as markets weighed a possible December Fed hike and the 10-year Treasury yield rose to about 4.86%; worries persisted that a Democratic-controlled Congress could slow data center construction, and Brent crude fell below US$100 a barrel.

text.en: Israeli President Herzog due to name who will form the next government; Eisenkot has 67 recommendations

text.en: China releases October CPI and PPI; Taiwan releases October trade data

week_note.zh: 11/2（台股）的收盤值，由次一交易日的收盤與漲跌點數推算。
week_note.en: The Nov 2 (Taiwan) close is derived from the next session's close and point change.
